name: Hive
author: Erin Carter
description: A honeycomb of glowing hexagonal tubes filling the frame edge to edge, with charge chasing around each cell rim and the hue drifting cell to cell. The outlines glow over a softly lit ground so the whole comb reads as one lit network.

params.label: Cell size
params.effect: Size of each hexagonal cell in CSS pixels - a dense fine comb at the minimum, broad open cells at the maximum.

params.label: Tube weight
params.effect: Core thickness of each glowing rim in CSS pixels, from a hairline outline to a fat neon edge.

params.label: Flow speed
params.effect: Speed of the charge chasing each cell rim; 0 freezes the light as static beads, high sends it racing around the comb.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Strength of the soft halo around each rim; low is a crisp drawn comb, high a luminous bloom that fills the cells with colour.

params.label: Weld
params.effect: Welds the per-cell rim chase into one continuous flow; low keeps each cell pulsing on its own phase, high sends a single wave sweeping seamlessly across every shared edge.

params.label: Colour blend
params.effect: Smooths the hue from a stepped cell-by-cell mosaic into a continuous gradient that drifts across cell edges without a seam.

params.label: Pattern
params.effect: Re-rolls the per-cell hue offsets and chase directions for a fresh arrangement of the same comb.

params.label: Cell fill
params.effect: Fraction of cells that light up as a solid glowing hexagon inside the rim; 0 leaves the comb hollow, high fills most cells with colour.

params.label: Fill size
params.effect: Size of each filled hexagon within its cell, from a small inner core to a block that nearly meets the rim.

params.label: Twinkle
params.effect: Makes the filled cells breathe in and out, each on its own random phase, so the comb shimmers.
